description: Match a ledger against a bank statement on id and amount, and list every exception. At month-end, when a ledger must be tied to a bank statement. Do not choose this when entries need fuzzy matching on reference or date. Example requests: Reconcile this ledger against the bank statement. | What does not match between these two files? | Find the breaks between my ledger and statement.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

ledger.description: The customer's ledger.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. The internal ledger rows. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

statement.description: The customer's statement.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. The bank statement rows. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_bank_statement_reconciler
title: Bank statement reconciler
